messages:
alex_w: Quick triage thread — I ran the audit coverage checklist for the services we promised customers and there are gaps we need to accept into backlog before sprint. Mostly: api-gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime.

maria_g: Can you list the specific missing events?

alex_w: TL;DR: missing policy-change and role-change events, incomplete request_id propagation, KMS key-use entries not surfaced to customer event schema, runtime pod-restarts show up only in infra logs (no user-facing audit event).

sam_t: +1 need concrete examples. Any samples?

alex_w: Pasted some snippets:

```
# api-gateway expected (v2 schema)
{"event_type":"request.start","request_id":"...","actor_id":"user:123","resource":"/v1/generate","outcome":"allowed"}
# current: request.start lacks request_id for internal retries and has no jwt_claims or client_id
```

jen_l: Oof. That request_id thing breaks correlation for customer logs.

kai_m: For auth: we have `policy.attached` in internal audit but missing `policy.updated` when RBAC role defs change via console vs API. Customers need authoritative records for compliance.

alex_w: Right. For KMS: key-usage is logged in KMS audit but our audit pipeline strips KMS key_id from exported events due to PII-scrubbing rules. We need a special-case field `kms_key_ref` that can be surfaced as hashed id for customers.

maria_g: Is that a schema change? bump to v2.1?

alex_w: Yes — proposal: schema v2.1 adds fields: `request_id`, `actor_raw` (redacted), `kms_key_ref`, `policy_version`, `role_delta`. Backward compatible: old fields remain.

sam_t: Who owns the schema PR and the validation harness for customer-facing events? I can take validation harness if someone opens the PR.

jen_l: I can open the schema PR and add the spec doc. Need acceptance criteria: examples for each service (api-gw, auth, console, billing, runtime). Also tests to ensure request_id flows through async retries and job queues.

alex_w: Action items: 1) jen_l create schema PR for v2.1 by EOD Fri; 2) sam_t implement event-validator tests in infra-audit by next Wed; 3) kai_m add missing auth events and owner code pointers; 4) maria_g run customer-impact doc for KMS change and check legal.

maria_g: I'll loop in legal/compliance about KMS hashed ids.

kai_m: For runtime: I propose mapping pod lifecycle to `runtime.instance.change` events with `outcome` and optional `root_cause` — that will give customers lifecycle evidence. Will start small patch to runtime-agent.

alex_w: Good. Also: billing needs `invoice.generated` and `invoice.adjusted` events surfaced with `actor_id` and `request_id` for charge disputes. Right now billing only writes internal ledger events.

sam_t: Noted. I'll make validator include synthetic billing events and run against staging stream.

jen_l: One more operational note: add a migration plan for consumers who currently parse v2 into e.g., Splunk. We should provide a compatibility table and a sample transform. I'll attach to the PR.

deploy-bot: PR #4823 (audit/schema: bump v2.1) created by jen_l — CI checks queued.

alex_w: Thanks — let's keep this short. We'll review progress in next security sync. If anyone hits blockers ping me or add to the backlog ticket `SEC-LOG-233` and tag owners. :white_check_mark:

audit-bot: NOTE: existing customers with exported audit snapshots will continue using v2 until opt-in to v2.1. Migration playbook: https://internal.company/audit-migration (draft).

jen_l: Created `SEC-LOG-233` and assigned temporary owners per action items. Will link PR when ready.

maria_g: Thanks all. I'll follow up with Legal and post status in #security-compliance channel.
